reusable_lessons.lesson: Treat catalogue defaults as unsafe until checked against the task text. Map every sentence of the objective to a component and parameter, override each default that diverges, and explicitly add any component the task needs that is not default-selected. Evidence: in T2 the defaults would have used denominator=all_claims for the denial rate, adjudication_date for the trend key, paid_amount only with no quantiles, no fraud_prevalence step, and a report with no denominators, no citations and no caveats; every one was overridden and the task passed with no failed checks and no evaluator feedback.

Choose each rate's denominator from the task's definition of the population, never from the default, and record numerator, denominator and both definitions. When the outcome can only occur for resolved units (e.g. denial), restrict the denominator to those units (adjudicated_claims) and exclude pending claims; when the task says 'across the whole portfolio', use all_claims. Evidence: T2 used adjudicated_claims for the denial rate and all_claims for fraud-label prevalence, each stated as numerator / denominator = rate, with no correctness findings.

In write_report always set show_denominators=true and cite_artifacts=true, and never leave caveats empty: include synthetic_data on every task, descriptive_only for non-modelling tasks, and add class_imbalance, model_limitations or no_operational_use where a model or the fraud label is involved. Evidence: T2 used show_denominators=true, cite_artifacts=true and caveats [synthetic_data, descriptive_only] and drew no communication or reproducibility findings.

Key any time series on the date column that names the event in the task (service start -> service_date_from; adjudication -> adjudication_date) rather than the default. The manifest shows adjudication_date runs to 2024-02 while service_date_from ends 2023-12, so the wrong key shifts monthly counts by weeks. Report the unparseable-date count and the first and last month alongside the series. Evidence: T2 keyed monthly volume on service_date_from as the task required and reported unparseable_dates from the component output.

Claim dollar fields are right-skewed, so summarise billed, allowed and paid with median, p90 and p99 as well as sum and mean (statistics=sum_mean_quantiles); a mean alone overstates the typical claim and hides the tail that high-cost and provider comparisons depend on. Evidence: T2 requested quantiles for all three amount columns and the financial section passed without findings.
